provenance.author: this repository
provenance.method: Galois descent to Q(w3), then exhaustive coplanarity scan of six-state configurations in exact arithmetic mod two primes

notes: Pairs with the verified rank-8 witness to put this cell at 7 <= chi <= 8. The Galois descent is made explicit: |T3>^3 = (psi_0 + w9 psi_1 + w9^2 psi_2)/sqrt(27) with psi_r supported on the coset x1+x2+x3 = r mod 3 and entries w3^q (q the carry), so a stabilizer span contains the state iff it contains V_3 = span{psi_0, psi_1, psi_2}, and the problem is over Q(w3). Six states whose span contains V_3 have images mod V_3 spanning at most 3 dimensions; the scan runs mod ell = 65521 with exact hashing (reduction and linear projection can only add candidates), the first pivot over the 45 orbits of the 2916 monomial (anti)unitary symmetries of V_3, the second pivot minimal in its orbit under the pivot stabilizer (326,368 pivot pairs). All members of a candidate class lie in one 6-dim space containing V_3, so one rank pair per class (class set, class set with the psi_r) decides every subset; the 259,423 classes are all rejected. Ranks are computed mod 2^31 - 1 and are exact by a Hadamard bound (minors of size <= 9 of root-of-unity matrices have norm below the prime), asserted per class, so the rejection is exact arithmetic, not least squares; the pipeline still records lower bounds as reproduced. Control inside the script: at m = 2 exactly three states lie in V_2 and the five-state scan finds class sets containing it. Outside it, the same kernel recovers the Lean rank-4 decomposition of |S>^3 as a class set, and shows the 45 rank-5 groups of the earlier certificate are one configuration under symmetry: five states spanning only three dimensions. Rank 7 was not excluded: the three-pivot scan costs about N^4/(6|G|) = 5e13 inner steps, about 70 CPU-hours in this kernel; simulated annealing at k = 7 stalls near residual 0.08 and an exact swap-neighbourhood search around the eight-term witness (three or more shared states) finds no seven-state span containing V_3.
